title: High confidence Citrix NetScaler CitrixBleed 2 memory leak indicator - STRICT
author: Adama ASSIONGBON (SOC & CTI Consultant), https://linkedin.com/in/adama-assiongbon-9029893a
description: Detects high-confidence Citrix NetScaler responses on sensitive Gateway endpoints with abnormally large response sizes from external sources consistent with CVE-2025-5777 memory disclosure. Threshold lowered to 10000 bytes. filter_known_admin_tools removed: curl and python-requests are common exploit delivery tools and must not be excluded here.
